code_or_query:
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
plt.xkcd()
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8,5))
ax.set_xlim(0,1.15); ax.set_ylim(0,0.65)
# start box 1.0 x 0.5
import matplotlib.patches as patches
ax.add_patch(patches.Rectangle((0.02,0.02),1.0,0.5,fill=False,lw=2,label='start box'))
ax.text(0.52,0.54,'START BOX 1.00 x 0.50 m',ha='center',fontsize=9)
# ground
ax.plot([0,1.12],[0.02,0.02],'k-',lw=2)
# wheels 300mm dia at x=0.15 and 0.80, wheelbase 0.65
import matplotlib.patches as mp
for x in [0.17,0.82]:
    c=plt.Circle((x,0.17),0.15,fill=False,lw=2)
    ax.add_patch(c)
    ax.text(x,0.17,'W\n300mm',ha='center',va='center',fontsize=7)
ax.annotate('',xy=(0.17,0.06),xytext=(0.82,0.06),arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='<->'))
ax.text(0.495,0.07,'wheelbase 0.65 m',ha='center',fontsize=8)
# frame 0.95 long x 0.10 tall at y ~0.30
ax.add_patch(patches.Rectangle((0.05,0.30),0.95,0.10,fill=False,lw=2))
ax.text(0.52,0.35,'FRAME 0.95x0.48m',ha='center',fontsize=8)
# lowered hopper inside frame
ax.add_patch(patches.Rectangle((0.55,0.32),0.30,0.12,fill=False,lw=2))
ax.text(0.70,0.38,'HOPPER\nlowered',ha='center',fontsize=7)
# folded mast flat to 0.45m height
ax.plot([0.15,0.90],[0.45,0.45],'k-',lw=3)
ax.text(0.52,0.47,'MAST stowed 0.45m high',ha='center',fontsize=8)
# drum front transverse
ax.add_patch(patches.Rectangle((0.02,0.12),0.12,0.12,fill=False,lw=2))
ax.text(0.08,0.18,'DRUM',ha='center',fontsize=7)
# dims length
ax.annotate('',xy=(0.02,0.60),xytext=(1.02,0.60),arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='<->'))
ax.text(0.52,0.61,'1.00 m limit / frame 0.95 m',ha='center',fontsize=8)
ax.set_aspect('equal'); ax.axis('off')
plt.tight_layout(); plt.savefig('sketch.png',dpi=150)
